stem:
Characteristics of mosses and apple trees are shown in the table.

| Mosses | Apple Trees |
|---|---|
| Grow on the surface of soil or on bare rock | Trunk and branches grow upward from roots in the soil |
| No roots; water absorbed by plants' outer surfaces | Water absorbed by roots and transported to leaves |
| No seeds; spores spread by wind and water | Seeds spread by animals |
| Life span of 2 to 10 years | Life span of 35 to 45 years |

Part A
Which statement BEST describes a survival advantage apple trees could have compared to mosses in certain environments?
instruction: This question has two parts. First, answer Part A. Then answer Part B.

options.label: A
options.text: Apple trees have easier access to surface water.

options.label: B
options.text: Apples can be transported more easily by wind.

options.label: C
options.text: Apple trees have shorter life spans.

options.label: D
options.text: Apple seeds are eaten and moved to faraway locations by animals.

visual_elements: Table with characteristics of mosses and apple trees
notes: Only Part A extracted as one STAAR problem.
